metadata.title: Hinge comparison and excess estimates via modified Hessian bounds on manifolds with density
metadata.abstract: We study geometric consequences of modified Hessian estimates on Riemannian manifolds with density. For general radial functions, we derive tensorial, spectral, and trace identities for the modified Hessian in the original metric. We also establish a comparison identity relating the modified Hessians of two radial functions and characterize when they are proportional. We then prove a hinge comparison theorem under an upper bound on the modified Hessian, yielding a weighted law of cosines and lower bounds for the excess function. Finally, under nonnegative weighted sectional curvature and suitable density control assumptions, we obtain an Abresch-Gromoll-type upper excess estimate.
